Whether a delay is certainly below the cut of the distribution function

Source: R/meta_summaries.R
dot-meta_deep_tail.Rd

Decided from a closed form bound on the parameters rather than from the distribution function, because in Stan the distribution function must not be evaluated where it underflows: its autodiff partial is then 0 / 0, and Stan's reverse pass chains every node on the stack, so the NaN poisons the gradient even when the value is discarded. The bounds are Phi(z) < exp(-100) for z < -14 for the lognormal, P(a, x) <= x^a / Gamma(a + 1) for the gamma and 1 - exp(-y) <= y for the weibull. Mirrors meta_family_deep_tail() in Stan.

Usage

.meta_deep_tail(q, dist, args)

Arguments

q

A numeric vector of delays.

dist

A primarycensored distribution function name.

args

A named list of distribution parameters.

Value

A logical vector.
